pubDescription: A big thank you to the people who support this site.
pubEmptyText: The first people to thank will appear here as soon as they have agreed.
suggestReason: keeps your people and their categories (to file your supporters in your address book)
meExplain: You support this site: thank you! If you wish, your nickname can appear on the supporters page. This is entirely optional and separate from your sign-up on the platform: without your agreement here, nothing is shown.
meStateNone: For now, you do not appear on the page.
meStatePending: Your nickname “{pseudo}” is waiting to be read before it appears.
meStateShown: Your nickname “{pseudo}” appears on the page.
mePseudoHelp: {max} characters at most. Not your real name if you prefer to stay discreet. No e-mail address, no link.
meAgree: I agree that this nickname is shown publicly on the supporters page.
meWithdraw: I no longer want to appear
meDoneShown: Thank you! Your nickname appears on the page.
meDonePending: Thank you! Your nickname will appear as soon as it has been read.
meDoneLeft: Done: you no longer appear on the page. You can come back to this link whenever you like.
mePrivacy: We only keep the nickname you choose here. No amount is ever shown. You can change your mind at any time on this same link.
errPseudoShort: This nickname is too short. Example: Luna42.
errPseudoLong: This nickname is too long ({max} characters at most). Shorten it.
errPseudoLink: A nickname cannot contain a link. Example: Luna42.
errPseudoEmail: A nickname cannot contain an e-mail address. Example: Luna42.
errPseudoChars: This nickname contains signs we cannot display. Use letters and digits. Example: Luna42.
errAgree: Tick the box to confirm that you agree.
errWait: Choose one of the two buttons.
errBusy: One moment, try again in a minute.
noRight: You can see this page but not change it. Ask the person who manages the site.
needToken: The platform's secret key is missing. Open the Settings tab, paste it in “Secret key from the platform” and save.
pageOff: The public page is off: nobody sees anything, and the agreement links do not work yet. Turn it on in the Settings tab when you are ready. It stays empty until someone has agreed.
sync_token: The platform refuses the secret key. Check that you copied all of it, without spaces, then paste it again in the Settings tab.
sync_scope: The platform refuses to let this key read your members. Check that it is the key of the page's creator.
sync_none: The platform cannot find your support page with this key. Check that it is the key of your creator account.
sync_busy: The platform asks you to wait (too many requests). Try again in a few minutes.
sync_unreachable: The platform does not answer right now. Try again in a few minutes: the supporters already known stay in place.
sync_unreadable: The platform answered something unexpected. Try again later.
sync_blocked: This address is not allowed for this platform. Nothing was sent.
sync_not_pull: This platform does not need a refresh: it tells the site by itself (or you import a file).
sync_partial: The list was too long to be read in full: the first members were taken into account.
tokenSaved: ✔ The secret key is saved (it is never shown again).
tokenMissing: The secret key is not saved yet. It is pasted in the Settings tab.
webhookLabel: Address to paste on the platform
refreshDone: Up to date: {n} supporters read ({added} new, {ended} stopped).
refreshPartial: Refreshed, but the list was too long to be read in full: {n} supporters read. Nobody was wrongly marked as stopped.
noEventYet: No notification received yet. The next gift will appear here by itself.
sumLine: In all: {total} supporters, {active} of them active. Agreed: {approved}. Nicknames to read: {pending}. Currently visible on the page: {shown}.
listEmpty: No supporters yet. They arrive as soon as the connection is made (or after a file import).
listNone: No supporter matches. Try another filter or search.
searchHelp: Part of a name or nickname. Example: Luna.
personAgreement: Nickname chosen by the person: “{pseudo}” (agreed on {on}).
linkIntro: Send this link to the person directly (for example as a message on the platform). They choose their nickname there and say yes or no. Nothing is shown before they agree.
linkNeedsPage: The public page is off: this link will only work once the page is on (Settings tab).
linkRenewTitle: A link leaked or you want to replace it?
linkRenew: Create a new link (the old one stops working)
linkRenewed: New link created. The old one no longer works.
approveIntro: The person chose the nickname “{pseudo}”. It is only shown after your green light.
approveNo: Refuse this nickname (the person can suggest another)
refused: Nickname refused: the person can suggest another one on their link.
noConsentYet: This person has not chosen a nickname yet: nothing to approve.
hideHelp: Hidden, they disappear from the public page, even with their agreement.
hiddenHelp: This person is hidden by you. Showing them again is not enough: they must also have agreed.
shownDone: This person is no longer hidden (they only appear if they have agreed).
forgetRow: Erases everything this module keeps about them. Their card in Contacts is not touched.
forgetConfirm: Forget this person? Their agreement is erased too. They will come back at the next refresh if they are still a member, but hidden.
tiersIntro: The public never sees the platform's tier names or amounts: only the labels you choose here. A tier without a label puts its people in the general group.
tiersNone: No tier yet. They appear after the first refresh, notification or import.
tierScreenHelp: This label is shown above the nicknames of this tier. Leave empty to put them in the general group.
tierLabelHelp: {max} characters at most, no amount. Example: Big supporter.
errLabelLong: This label is too long ({max} characters at most). Shorten it.
errLabelAmount: A label must not contain an amount. Example: Big supporter.
errSave: Saving did not work. Try again in a moment.
tplHelp: Gives a label to each tier, from lowest to highest. You can change everything afterwards.
tpl_three: Three levels: Supporter, Big supporter, Patron
tpl_none: No label (everyone in a single group)
errTemplate: Choose a template in the list.
contactsIntro: Contacts keeps the people of your site. You can file your supporters there, in the category of your choice. Nothing is ever written to Contacts without your click on the button below, and only if you have the right to.
contactsAbsent: The Contacts module is not installed: it is not required. The names given by the platform are then kept here, and that is all.
cat_none: No category chosen. In the Settings tab, type “Supporters” in “Contacts category for supporters” then click “Create”.
cat_choose: Choose the supporters' Contacts category in the Settings tab (for example “Supporters”).
cat_gone: The chosen category no longer exists in Contacts. Choose another one in the Settings tab.
cat_unverified: Contacts could not confirm the category. Try again in a moment.
cat_absent: The Contacts module is not installed.
noFileRight: You do not have the right to file people in Contacts. Ask the person who manages the site.
fileDone: Filed in Contacts: {filed} supporters ({created} new cards). {left} left to file.
fileStop_absent: Contacts does not answer: stopping here.
fileStop_slow: Contacts takes too long to answer: stopping here, try again.
fileStop_failed: A card could not be filed: try again.
wallStopped: The thank-you wall could not be updated: try again.
importIntro: Your platform is not in the list, or its connection does not work? Import your supporters yourself: a CSV file (or a list pasted from a spreadsheet), {rows} lines at most. Useful columns: name (required), tier, since, status. Importing the same file again creates no duplicate.
importPasteHelp: First line: the column titles. Example: name;tier;since
importReplace: Those not in this file are no longer active
importReplaceHelp: Tick if the file is the complete list of your supporters today.
errImportEmpty: Choose a file or paste a list.
errImportBig: This file is too big ({kb} KB at most).
errImportHead: You need a first line with the column titles, then at least one person. Example: name;tier
errImportName: I cannot find the names column. Call it “name” or “nom” on the first line.
errImportMany: Too many lines ({max} at most). Split the file in two.
errImportNoRows: No usable line (line {line}: empty name or unreadable date, for example 2026-03-01).
tidyIntro: Supporters who stopped more than {days} days ago are forgotten by themselves when someone refreshes the list. You can do it right now. Cards in Contacts are never touched.
tierRankHelp: Higher levels are shown first. Example: 3.
errRank: Enter a whole number between 1 and 60. Example: 3.
